LegalModals.termsClause1Text: Participants in national hackathons must provide truthful profile information and meet specific competition rules set by organizing committees.
LegalModals.termsClause2Text: Competitors retain full ownership of their submitted project code, designs, and pitch materials unless explicitly specified by competition sponsors.
LegalModals.termsClause3Text: We enforce a zero-tolerance policy against harassment, plagiarism, intellectual property theft, or malicious code submission.
LegalModals.termsClause4Text: Ethiopian government guidelines and Ministry of Innovation standards apply to all distributed grants, incubations, and prize disbursements.
LegalModals.privacyClause1Text: We collect account profile data, team submissions, and communication preferences to facilitate hackathon participation and startup verification.
LegalModals.privacyClause2Text: Your information is strictly used for platform administration, team matching, and connecting validated startups with global investors.
LegalModals.privacyClause3Text: All user credentials and verified identity documents are encrypted using enterprise-grade security protocols.
LegalModals.privacyClause4Text: We never sell user data to third-party advertisers. Data is shared with government partners solely for official grant distribution and verification.
LegalModals.policyClause1Text: Qualified startups receive tax holidays and customs duty waivers for capital equipment imports required for research and software development.
LegalModals.policyClause2Text: Fast-tracked patent filing and IP registration support through the Ethiopian Intellectual Property Authority.
LegalModals.policyClause3Text: Simplified access to foreign currency allocations for cloud infrastructure subscriptions and global developer tooling.
LegalModals.policyClause4Text: Government agencies reserve a minimum 15% quota for local startup solutions in digital transformation and public infrastructure contracts.
